whole_frame_support.whole_frame_analysis: The daughter sees an asserted fact, hence indicative wæs in the content clause. Wæs getogen describes his education/training in good accomplishments, not physical pulling. Gefēoll has nominative mōd as its singular subject; hiere is the possessor and on his lufe gives the figurative falling-in-love result. Supply the complete idiom and the rare participle.
